title: Katelin Holloway – Human Side of Venture Investing at 776 (EP.490)

reader_summary.source_label: From the episode notes — transcript not yet available
reader_summary.headline: Katelin Holloway is a Founding Partner at Seven Seven Six.
reader_summary.overview: Katelin Holloway is a Founding Partner at Seven Seven Six, a technology-focused venture firm backing great early-stage entrepreneurs that she started with Alexis Ohanian in 2020. Alexis was a past guest on the show, and that conversation is replayed in the feed. Katelin and I explore the intersection of human capital and venture capital.

key_points.text: We cover her upbringing, work alongside Steve Jobs at Pixar, and turnaround of Reddit with Alexis.
We then turn to the application of her operational experience to venture investing.
We discuss 776's sourcing and underwriting of founders, interviewing approach, investment selection.
